Byrd]] | party2 = Democratic Party (United States) | popular_vote2 = | percentage2 = | title = U.S. senator | before_election = [[Cynthia Lummis]] | before_party = Republican Party (United States) | after_election = | after_party = }} {{ElectionsWY}} The '''2026 United States Senate election in Wyoming''' will be held on November 3, 2026, to elect a member of the [[United States Senate]] to represent the state of [[Wyoming]]. [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] congresswoman [[Harriet Hageman]] and [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] former state representative [[James W. Byrd]] are the nominees for their respective parties. Republican incumbent [[Cynthia Lummis]] is not seeking a second term. [[Primary elections]] were held on August 18. In the Republican primary, Hageman won the nomination with 64.9% of the vote against former Kirby mayor Sam Mead. Byrd won the Democratic nomination with 79.3% of the vote, facing minimal opposition. Democrats have not won a Senate race in Wyoming since [[1970 United States Senate election in Wyoming|1970]]. == Republican primary == === Candidates === ==== Nominee ==== * [[Harriet Hageman]], [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. representative]] from [[Wyoming's at-large congressional district]] (2023–present){{cite web|last=Steinhauser|first=Paul|date=December 23, 2025|title=Scoop: Trump ally who ousted Cheney launches Senate bid keep GOP seat in Republican hands|url=https://www.foxnews.com/politics/scoop-trump-ally-harriet-hageman-who-ousted-cheney-launches-senate-bid-keep-gop-seat-republican-hands|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20261010194137/https://www.foxnews.com/politics/scoop-trump-ally-harriet-hageman-who-ousted-cheney-launches-senate-bid-keep-gop-seat-republican-hands|archive-date=October 10, 2026|publisher=[[Fox News]]|access-date=December 23, 2025}} ==== Eliminated in primary ==== * Jill M.
